SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Public resolver returns URLs and metadata; Gateway does not proxy media bytes.
Create adds publicUrl only; appDeepLink is a resolver response field.
Token collision loop is bounded at five pre-insert checks; an insert error propagates, not a guaranteed retry.
